verdict.rationale: Poly's first-party docs describe a built-in Poly agent that sees the file or folder you are viewing. It can summarize, explain, edit, create and organize files, and handle multi-step tasks such as extracting invoice data into a CSV in a single request. Edits are preserved in version history, and the agent can spawn subagents to split up and track work. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent performs delegated tasks reliably (all evidence is vendor docs).
